initial_turn.body:
Hey there,

I hope you’re having a good day! I’m reaching out from Fresh HelloFoods because we’re looking to streamline our purchasing process and wanted to get a better understanding of how your ordering system works. Specifically, could you walk me through what information you need from us to place an order? Best regards,
Fresh HelloFoods
